cases.name: Intentional demonstration
fully checked release scores 100 and is ready to rehearse
unchecked critical gates hold the release even when most items are done
missing noncritical work needs attention without inventing blockers
all-unchecked plan has zero score and exactly four critical blockers
timeline computes UTC dates across year and leap-day boundaries
validated plans trim user text and retain Unicode without mutating input
unknown fields, missing fields and non-object bodies are rejected
checklist requires exact IDs and genuine JSON booleans
semantic-version validation accepts prerelease/build IDs and rejects malformed versions
invalid dates and ambiguous date formats do not roll into another day
text fields reject blank, long and control-character values
health and version endpoints expose the actual supplied build metadata
browser shell and local assets are served with appropriate media types
HEAD returns metadata and no body for supported read routes
HTTP assessment completes the browser-to-API calculation path
request tracing and browser protection headers are present
malformed JSON, wrong media type and failed validation return helpful JSON errors
oversized request is rejected without accepting a partial payload
chunked oversized JSON is capped without retaining its unbounded body
unknown routes, methods, traversal and unsupported queries are rejected
independent server instances calculate identical plans without stored server state
